subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 be allowed to close this issue with the provider-name description and schema test, or should enum support remain in scope here?
rationale: The source gap and narrow description fix are clear, but the issue title includes enum support while the body treats it as optional and a static enum could drift from registered channel/plugin ids.

options.title: Accept Description-Only Closure
options.body: Land the provider-name description and schema test, close this issue, and track enum behavior separately only if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Keep Enum In Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open until a dynamic enum design is implemented or explicitly rejected.

options.title: Split The Follow-Up
options.body: Land the linked PR as a partial fix and immediately move enum support into a narrower product/API follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Description-Only Closure
recommendation.body: Land the provider-name description and schema test, close this issue, and track enum behavior separately only if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history signal on the message-tool and outbound channel-selection boundary and already reviewed this issue’s scope.
